question: Does the simpler summed-writer scalar compiler trained on Later/Previously predict reader magnitudes and causal behavior on the distinct Tomorrow/Earlier construction?

authority.destination_test_terminal: writer_summary_insufficient; summed baseline is simpler and matched destination-resolved correlation

novelty: Prior prediction used heldout nouns and the A2 frame within the Later/Previously authority. This is the first frozen coefficient compiler transfer to different cue tokens and the original Tomorrow/Earlier bare/report templates.

frozen_design.fit: the exact balanced 16-row A1 subset from the destination test, containing eight examples of each intervention orientation
frozen_design.ood: all 32 A1, 32 A2, and 32 aligned P rows from temporal_auxiliary.will_vs_had (Tomorrow/Earlier)
frozen_design.writer_feature: one SVD coefficient of the sum of the two exact block8H1 subject-destination cue writes
frozen_design.reader_targets: separate rank-one coefficients for block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3
frozen_design.compiler: two affine maps, four fitted scalars; fitted only on Later/Previously A1

predictions.pred_a_ood_capability_and_writer_closure: all OOD answer-changing rows are natively correct and direct writer reconstruction error <=1e-4 on fit/A1/A2/P
predictions.pred_b_ood_coefficient_prediction: both reader coefficient correlations have absolute r>=0.60 in OOD A1 and A2
predictions.pred_c_ood_program_material: predicted program retains >=0.60 of full captured response and is donorward on >=0.75 of OOD A1/A2 rows
predictions.pred_d_prediction_beats_intercept: predicted recovery exceeds intercept-only by >=0.15 of full response on OOD A1 and A2
predictions.pred_f_price_exact: 38 forwards, 1104 examples, 320 unique records, four scalars, 512 axes, zero backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, OOD capability, alignment, writer closure, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.cue_specific: valid test but reader coefficients or causal execution do not transfer
terminal_rules.behavioral_null: coefficients correlate but installed responses are not causal

interpretation_limits: A pass identifies OOD prediction across two cue lexicons and two frames, not unrestricted temporal language.
The compiler remains empirical and uses exact writer terms supplied by the native block8 attention calculation.
C selectivity remains inherited because that family lacks an aligned writer interface.
